# Config reference: renderer parameters

The keys a `plots.<panel>` block of a project config can hold, per renderer, from each renderer's `SCHEMA` (the same descriptions `fa ingest bundle` and `fa param scaffold` write into configs). *auto* means unset: the renderer decides (e.g. axis limits from the data); *computed* means the renderer derives it from other values. Units: pt = points (1 pt = 0.35 mm), mm on the page, data coords = the axis's own units.

## bar_scatter

`fig_atlas.renderers:render_bar_scatter`

| Key | Type | Default | Unit | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `category_col` | text | `symbol` |  | Column holding the x categories |
| `category_order` | list | auto |  | Category order, left to right (default: order in the data) |
| `groups` | list | `[]` |  | Wide table: series per category, a list of {label, color, columns} (replicate columns) |
| `group_col` | text | auto |  | Long table (one row per replicate): column with the series; then value_col holds the values and groups is built from group_order/group_colors/group_labels |
| `value_col` | text | `value` |  | Long table: column with the replicate values |
| `group_order` | list | auto |  | Long table: series order (default: order in the data) |
| `group_colors` | mapping | `{}` | hex color | Long table: bar colour per series |
| `group_labels` | mapping | `{}` |  | Long table: legend label per series |
| `pvalue_col` | text | auto |  | Column with the per-category p-value for the two-group bracket |
| `bar_width` | number | `0.8` | x units (one category = 1) | Total width of one category's bars |
| `bar_edgecolor` | colour | `none` | color | Bar outline colour |
| `bar_edgewidth` | number | `0.0` | pt | Bar outline width |
| `errorbar` | one of `sem`, `sd` | `sem` |  | Error bar: standard error or standard deviation |
| `errorbar_width` | number | `1.0` | pt | Error bar and cap line width |
| `capsize` | number | `3.0` | pt | Error bar cap length |
| `show_points` | true / false | `True` |  | Overlay the replicate values as dots |
| `point_color` | colour | `#111111` | hex color | Replicate dot colour |
| `point_edgecolor` | colour | `white` | color | Replicate dot outline |
| `point_edgewidth` | number | `0.4` | pt | Replicate dot outline width |
| `point_size` | number | `20` | pt^2 (marker area) | Replicate dot size |
| `point_jitter` | number | `0.06` | x units | Horizontal jitter of the dots |
| `point_seed` | integer | `0` | random seed | Seed of the jitter (fixed for reproducible output) |
| `show_significance` | true / false | `True` |  | Draw the star bracket when there are exactly two groups |
| `sig_thresholds` | list | `[[0.001, '***'], [0.01, '**'], [0.05, '*']]` | p-value | [threshold, symbol] pairs, ascending |
| `sig_ns_display` | text | `ns` |  | Text for non-significant pairs (empty to hide) |
| `sig_font_size` | number | computed | pt | Star size (default tick_label_size + 1) |
| `sig_gap` | number | `0.03` | fraction of the data top | Gap between bars and bracket |
| `sig_line_color` | colour | `#333333` | hex color | Bracket line colour |
| `sig_line_width` | number | `1.0` | pt | Bracket line width |
| `y_min` | number | `0` | data coords | Lower y limit |
| `y_max` | number | auto | data coords | Upper y limit (default: data top x y_headroom) |
| `y_headroom` | number | `1.28` | multiple of the data top | Space above the bars for the brackets — raise if stars touch the top |
| `grid` | true / false | `True` |  | Draw horizontal grid lines |
| `grid_alpha` | number | `0.3` | alpha [0-1] | Grid line opacity |
| `despine` | true / false | `True` |  | Hide the top and right spines |
| `xtick_rotation` | number | `0` | degrees | Category label rotation |
| `xtick_mode` | one of `category`, `group` | `category` |  | x tick labels: one per category, or one per bar named by its group (e.g. a single two-group comparison) |
| `show_legend` | true / false | `True` |  | Show the group legend |
| `legend_loc` | text | `upper right` |  | Legend location (matplotlib loc string) |
| `legend_ncol` | integer | `1` | columns | Legend columns |
| `legend_frameon` | true / false | `False` |  | Draw a frame around the legend |
| `legend_fontsize` | number | computed | pt | Legend font size (default tick_label_size) |
| `labels_title` | text | auto |  | Panel title |
| `labels_xlabel` | text | computed |  | x-axis title (default: category_col) |
| `labels_ylabel` | text | `Value` |  | y-axis title |
| `title_size` | number | `12` | pt | Panel title font size |
| `title_weight` | text | `bold` |  | Panel title weight (matplotlib: bold, normal, ...) |
| `axes_label_size` | number | `10` | pt | Axis title font size |
| `axes_label_weight` | text | `bold` |  | Axis title weight (matplotlib: bold, normal, ...) |
| `tick_label_size` | number | `8` | pt | Tick label font size |

| `species_divider_color` | colour | `#CBD5E1` | hex color | Line between the two species of a condition |

## cross_condition_dotplot

`fig_atlas_omics.renderers:render_cross_condition_dotplot`

| Key | Type | Default | Unit | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `title_size` | number | style `typography.title_size` (else `13`) | pt | Panel title font size — lower if the title wraps or crowds the panel |

| `term_col` | text | `GO Term` |  | Column of df with the term (row) names |
| `condition_col` | text | `Condition` |  | Column of df with the condition (column) names |
| `value_col` | text | `Signed -log10(FDR)` |  | Column of df with the value mapped to colour |

| `condition_order` | list | auto |  | Column order (default: order of first appearance) |

| `top_n_up` | integer | auto | terms | Keep only the top N UP terms per condition |
| `top_n_down` | integer | auto | terms | Keep only the top N DOWN terms per condition |
| `cmap` | colormap | `RdBu_r` |  | Colormap for value_col |
| `color_auto` | true / false | `True` |  | Colour range symmetric around 0 from the data (else color_min / color_max) |
| `color_min` | number | `-10.0` | value units | Lower end of the colour range when color_auto is false |
| `color_max` | number | `10.0` | value units | Upper end of the colour range when color_auto is false |

## Recipes

A recipe is a core shape with a field's defaults and parameter names; `fig_atlas.render("<name>", ...)` draws it.
